review_candidates.title: Senior Account Executive - DACH Market
review_candidates.description: About The Company At Smartness , we are building the future of hospitality tech. Our SaaS helps lodging providers boost revenues by 30%+ and get more direct bookings. We are the fastest-growing B2B SaaS in the industry, trusted by 4,000+ clients across 40+ countries , with billions of euros in bookings processed. Backed by top international investors and named one of Italy's Top 10 LinkedIn Startups, we are on a mission to scale globally. Want to grow with us? Let's go! About The Role What Will You Do? 🦾 As a Member Of Smartness' Sales Team For The DACH Market. You Will Be Part Of a Cohesive Team Whose Goal Is To Make Us The No. 1 Hospitality Software In The Region. You Will Participate In Both In-person And Remote Training Sessions. You Will Support The Sales Team In The Expansion Of Smartness In The DACH Market (Germany, Swiss German And Austria) Through Activities Of Sales negotiation - you will manage a busy schedule of online and in-person appointments with potential prospects interested in learning about Smartness. You will articulate and clearly demonstrate our value proposition, creating enthusiasm among prospects. Participation in trade fairs and events - Smartness is present at all major national trade fairs. You will attend 1-2 trade fairs per year and have the opportunity to organize on-site meetings with customers. Business Development - you will proactively search for new business opportunities, through cold calling and cold emailing. Data analysis and regular reviews - you will hone your analytical skills by learning how to critically read through your pipeline, using the best and most advanced sales tools on the market! Reaching the monthly target - your main goal will be to reach and exceed the ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) target with an incentivizing bonus plan. What We’re Looking For 👀 German language - Mother Tongue or C2 level Good English skills B2 level - We are an international company, we want you to be able to understand and interact with others effectively. Team player with winning mentality - your desire is to consistently exceed 100% of the monthly quota, and you are willing to make sacrifices so that your colleagues reach it too. Data-driven thinking- you are skilled at analyzing and interpreting data, making decisions based on quantitative evidence, continuously improving business strategies through the effective use of data. Desire to learn - you are willing to receive on the field coaching sessions and you are eager to read books on how to improve your sales skills. Training can take place in-person or remotely. We like to meet from time to time to share company values. Experience in the role - you have at least 3 - 5 years previous experience in a sales team (SaaS, Software, Services) where you brilliantly exceeded your sales targets. Organization - you pay attention to detail, maniacally plan your agenda and update the CRM in a timely manner. Productivity - you have a strong motivation to sell into the SMEs market, managing short and intense sales cycles. What Do We Offer? 👌 Work in a small and top-performing team that moves extremely fast where you are extremely important. Work without having to deal with jerks and ego-maniacs. The opportunity to join one of the best travel-tech sales teams in Europe. A place where your talent can blossom. An environment where mistakes are allowed – we make bold choices to achieve ambitious goals, learn from mistakes, and move forward. A place where your voice matters – meetings provide space for new ideas and projects, regardless of your role or seniority. Continuous growth – we challenge the status quo, renewing our sales processes and approaches to meet challenging goals. We have fun while working! We are easygoing people. Work with the best software out there to automate repetitive tasks and let you focus on customers and targets. Remote working. Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives. For our Sales team for the DACH market, we typically offer an OTE package ranging from €70,000 to €120.000 annually, depending on experience, commercial track record, market knowledge and expected impact - plus the opportunity to receive equity, aligning your success with the long-term growth of the company. Our compensation structure is designed to reward ambition, ownership, and consistent results. The OTE includes both a fixed salary and a variable component linked to individual and team performance, providing significant upside for high achievers. As you grow within the company and contribute to business expansion, customer acquisition, and revenue growth, compensation can evolve rapidly to reflect your impact and responsibilities. For exceptional candidates with proven sales capabilities or strategic expertise, we may consider compensation packages beyond the standard ranges. Still not convinced? Check out our "Work With Us" page for more about our mission, values, and why we love working at Smartpricing: Lavora con noi - Unisciti alla missione di Smartness Before you apply If you're reading this, it means you're genuinely interested, and that excites us! Here's what you need to know: We're highly driven and set our goals higher than most, pushing boundaries others may deem impossible. We work much harder than most companies out there. Every day, we step out of our comfort zones, fueling rapid growth and learning, even though it might come with its stress. We hold ourselves and our team to the highest standards of excellence and culture. Should we feel that this role isn't the right match for you, for the benefit of both parties, we may need to part ways. We hope this sheds light on whether this could be your next adventure. If you believe it is, we warmly invite you to apply. Discover your full potential with us! A quick heads-up: we reply to every candidate. If you're waiting for an update, please check your spam/junk folder too - sometimes our emails end up there. We wouldn't want you to miss a message from us! By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.

review_candidates.title: Senior Account Executive
review_candidates.description: Hey there! We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment. Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment. Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment! Ready to be part of the experience? Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission. Meet The Team Fever for Business (F4B) is our B2B organization , built around a simple idea: providing live experiences as a service to other businesses. We help businesses, schools and global brands create memorable events without the usual complexity by providing a reliable, scalable, and high-quality service. From intimate Candlelight Private Concert or a large-scale multi-city activation , we turn live entertainment into a repeatable business solution that drives employee engagement and brand differentiation. Our team owns the full journey from initial sales and strategy to global execution working closely with Fever Originals and Operations to scale B2B experiences smoothly and at a global level. Join us if you are excited about redefining B2B entertainment, build global partnerships, and turn world-class culture into a seamless business service. The Role We are looking for a tenured Sr. Account Executive to help build and scale our emerging Fever for Business unit across LATAM, bringing the full power of Fever to corporate and institutional clients in a fast-growing market. In this role, you will take ownership of a targeted book of business within the Strategic & Enterprise segments, while also shaping our local go-to-market approach - defining strategy, advising prospects on their needs within the culture and live entertainment space and driving net new revenue. Your expertise in consultative selling, combined with strong deal execution and cross-functional alignment, will be critical to accelerating our expansion and establishing a high-impact B2B presence in the region. What You'll Do Own the relationship with Fever’s Enterprise and Strategic prospects and clients in your territory Consistently meet and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets Take ownership in pipeline creation and deal cycle management, applying MEDDIC-style Sales methodologies Drive New Logo growth and a land & expand motion for our top tier customers Leverage Fever’s ecosystem and your own network to identify and engage ideal prospects Identify, map, and multi-thread key stakeholders in your territory Craft and execute creative outreach strategies to drive pipeline quality Build lasting client relationships that generate recurring revenue Collaborate cross-functionally (Marketing, Partners, Operations) to ensure alignment Conduct market research to stay informed about industry trends and competitors Thrive on change while remaining highly organized, adaptable, optimistic, and coachable Maintain CRM hygiene, forecast accuracy, and high customer service standards Who You Are 5+ years in B2B sales (SaaS, Media, Entertainment, MICE or similar a plus) Proven track record of achieving Sales targets Experience with MEDDIC/SPIN or similar methodologies is preferred Strong negotiation and problem-solving skills; confident with senior stakeholders Entrepreneurial self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change Excellent written & verbal communication skills Ability to work independently and as part of a team Growth mindset: coachable, data-driven, organized, optimistic Fluency in English and Portuguese. Why You'll Love It Here Attractive compensation package with room to grow. FGTS Protection: Monthly contributions to your Length-of-Service Guarantee Fund, building a safety net for your future. 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher. Private health, life & dental insurance: Amil coverage 100% paid by Fever. Swile Meal Card: R$900 monthly for food and dining, 100% paid by Fever. Swile Mobility: R$280 monthly allowance for seamless commuting and transportation. Wellhub membership for gym and wellness access: paid by Fever up to the Silver plan. Vacation Bonus: An extra financial boost to help you recharge and enjoy your time off. Hybrid work setup: home office friendly with a central Sao Paulo office location. Language learning support: English and Spanish lessons. Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you! If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply! If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey. If you want to know more about how Fever processes your personal data, click here Fever - Candidate Privacy Notice

review_candidates.description: Sales Manager – Air & Sea Vantaa, Finland | Hybrid Build the future of Air & Sea logistics in Finland At LEMAN, we believe logistics is about more than moving goods. It is about creating opportunities, building trusted relationships, and helping customers grow. To strengthen our Air & Sea business in Finland, we are looking for a commercially driven Sales Manager – Air & Sea who thrives on winning new business and creating growth from the ground up. This is not a traditional account management role. We are looking for a true hunter who enjoys opening doors, developing long-term customer relationships, and creating sustainable growth in the market. If you have experience within freight forwarding, understand the opportunities within Air & Sea logistics, and enjoy building something rather than maintaining something, this could be your next career move. Position Facts Location: Vantaa, Finland (Hybrid) Reporting to: Head of Sales Finland Business Area: Air & Sea Freight Forwarding Travel: Regular customer visits across Finland with flexibility in planning travel activities Company Car: Included Languages: Finnish and English The Opportunity As Sales Manager – Air & Sea, you will be responsible for developing new business opportunities across Finland and contributing directly to LEMAN’s future growth. Reporting directly to the Head of Sales Finland, you will work closely with local management and operational teams while enjoying a high degree of autonomy and responsibility. You will play a key role in increasing market awareness of LEMAN’s Air & Sea services, building new customer relationships, and driving long-term profitable growth. This role offers significant freedom to plan your activities, develop your market approach, and build your own success. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute a proactive new business strategy across Finland Identify, pursue and win new Air & Sea customers Build and manage a healthy sales pipeline Conduct customer meetings, presentations and commercial negotiations Build long-term relationships with decision-makers and stakeholders Work closely with operations to ensure successful onboarding of new customers Strengthen LEMAN’s visibility and Air & Sea presence in the Finnish market Contribute actively to the growth journey of LEMAN Finland Travel and Customer Presence Success in this role requires visibility in the market and close customer relationships. You enjoy meeting customers face-to-face, understanding their business challenges and creating logistics solutions that support their growth. The role includes regular travel throughout Finland to meet customers and develop new business opportunities. While personal customer visits remain an important part of the role, there is flexibility in how activities are planned and balanced between customer visits, virtual meetings, and business development activities. For the right person, this is an opportunity to become one of the commercial faces of LEMAN in Finland. What You Bring To succeed in this role, you likely bring: Experience within Air & Sea freight forwarding Strong understanding of international logistics and supply chains A proven hunter mentality and passion for winning new business The ability to create trust and build long-term customer relationships A self-driven and entrepreneurial mindset Strong communication and negotiation skills Strong commercial mindset Fluency in Finnish and professional proficiency in English Why Join LEMAN? At LEMAN, you will have the opportunity to make a visible impact. Unlike larger and more bureaucratic organisations, we offer short decision-making processes, a high degree of autonomy, and the opportunity to directly influence the growth journey of the business. You will become part of an ambitious Nordic logistics company where relationships, trust, collaboration, and entrepreneurship define how we work. What We Offer Competitive salary package Company car with full benefit package Comprehensive private healthcare scheme Lunch benefit Annual culture and sports allowance Flexible and hybrid working environment Strong local leadership and supportive colleagues High degree of autonomy and responsibility Entrepreneurial and collaborative company culture Opportunity to shape future commercial growth Why This Role Is Different This role is about creating opportunities, not maintaining existing business. You will play a vital role in expanding LEMAN’s Air & Sea footprint in Finland, developing new customer relationships, and helping shape the future direction of the business. For the right person, this position offers a unique opportunity to combine freedom, responsibility, and commercial impact in a highly visible role. Ready to Make an Impact? If you are passionate about Air & Sea logistics, motivated by new business development, and looking for an opportunity where your efforts will truly make a difference, we would love to hear from you. Join LEMAN and help accelerate the growth of our Air & Sea business across Finland. About Us LEMAN is a global company with deep roots and a modern, people-centric approach. We believe in empowering our colleagues and creating an environment where everyone feels valued, heard, and inspired to perform at their best. Every day, we provide customised logistics and transport solutions that make a difference for companies and people around the world. We’re large enough to deliver top-quality global supply chain solutions yet small enough to offer truly personal experience – for both our customers and each other.

review_candidates.title: Sales Executive | België | Remote
review_candidates.description: Saga is een legal AI company met de missie om alles weg te halen wat tussen juridische expertise en echte impact staat, zodat advocaten zich kunnen richten op wat het meest telt: mensen, ethiek en impact. Juridische teams veranderen niet vaak hoe ze werken. En als ze het doen, staat die keuze meestal jaren. De meeste teams maken die keuze nu, over AI. Waar ze voor kiezen, bepaalt nog lang hoe hun cliënten het recht ervaren. Daarom zien we deze gesprekken als meer dan een verkoop. We nemen liever de tijd om een team naar het juiste antwoord te helpen, dan dat we het een beslissing in duwen die later stilletjes wordt teruggedraaid. Jouw rol als Sales Executive bij Saga De meeste advocatenkantoren in België hebben nog nooit gezien wat AI echt met hun werk kan doen. Jij bent diegene die het hun toont. Soms is dat een gesprek van 20 minuten waarin iemand beleefd afhoudt. En soms is het het moment waarop een vennoot even stil valt en zegt: dit scheelt me een halve dag per week. Voor dat tweede doe je het. Jij trekt de outbound groei in België. Je zoekt kantoren op, kwalificeert ze en legt contact via research, telefoon, mail, LinkedIn en events. Je voert discovery calls waarin de echte behoefte naar boven komt en geeft demo's die impact maken. Wat je gaat doen Jij bepaalt hoe we de Belgische markt aanpakken. Welke kantoren, langs welke weg, met welke opening. Je stuurt bij zodra je merkt wat aanslaat. Je bouwt en runt de volledige pipeline zelf: eerste contact, discovery, demo, bezwaren, onderhandeling. Je staat er niet alleen voor, het Saga team denkt mee. Je vertaalt wat je in de markt hoort naar een Belgisch playbook en deelt dat met sales, marketing en product. Wat jij hier leert, maakt ons overal beter. Je bouwt relaties die blijven duren, bij advocatenkantoren, juridische netwerken en lokale partners. Op events en workshops in heel het land ben jij het gezicht van Saga. Je houdt je pipeline realistisch en up-to-date in HubSpot, zodat jij en iedereen rond jou hetzelfde beeld van de markt hebben. Wat je aan kennis en ervaring meebrengt Je bent een commercieel professional die graag werkt in een omgeving met tempo. Je weet hoe je prospecteert, kwalificeert en deals vooruit helpt. Een nee blijft niet aan je plakken. En je kent dat moment waarop lauwe interesse omslaat in een concrete afspraak. Daar doe je het voor. Ervaring in B2B sales, account management of business development, in SaaS, technologie of professional services. Aantoonbare ervaring met het opzetten en uitvoeren van een go-to-market aanpak voor complexe SaaS-producten. Ervaring met pipelinebeheer in een CRM zoals HubSpot of Salesforce. Sterke communicatie. Je voert discovery calls, geeft demo's en pakt bezwaren aan zonder dat het vertrouwen eronder lijdt. Interesse in waar AI echt iets bijbrengt in juridisch werk, en genoeg voeling met hoe advocaten werken om snel hun vertrouwen te winnen. Je bent woonachtig in België en kunt commerciële gesprekken en onderhandelingen in het Nederlands, Frans en Engels voeren. Waarom kiezen voor Saga We zijn met juristen, engineers en bouwers, verspreid over meerdere landen en continenten. Klein genoeg dat je iedereen kent, groot genoeg dat er ervaring is met groeien over de grenzen heen. Werk je graag in een platte organisatie waar je zelf aan het stuur zit? Dan zit je hier goed. Wat we bieden: Een brutojaarloon van €55.000 tot €65.000, afhankelijk van ervaring, plus een bonusregeling. Betaalde verlofdagen, IT-materiaal en een vergoeding voor je verplaatsingen. Directe impact en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag 1. Ruimte om te experimenteren, en de steun om het te doen lukken. Remote set-up met hubs in Oslo en Amsterdam waar je altijd terechtkunt. Werk over de volledige breedte: van klantgesprekken tot meedenken met developers en juristen over het product. Een English-first werkomgeving met Noorse wortels en een groeiende Europese aanwezigheid. Wil jij België opbouwen voor Saga? Dan maken we graag kennis. Solliciteer via LinkedIn of neem contact op met Natalia Brodecka via natalia.brodecka@sagalegal.io.

The Vice President will have overall responsibility for regional business development and the broader European business, while the Sales Director will have specific responsibility for sales leadership, sales execution and delivery against agreed commercial objectives . The successful candidate will be expected to build relationships with major customers and partners, lead significant opportunities, develop the sales team, establish effective sales operations and continuously improve sales performance. Identify opportunities to increase sales across certifications, training, partnerships, awards and related products and services. Develop appropriate sales channels, territories and routes to market. Monitor sales performance and take corrective action where required. Building & Leading the Sales Team Recruit and build a high-performing sales team in the Netherlands and across relevant European markets. Establish appropriate sales roles, territories, responsibilities and reporting structures. Set clear objectives, targets and performance expectations. Establish a strong culture of accountability, performance and continuous improvement. Coach, mentor and develop sales team members. Establish effective onboarding, training and sales development programmes. Manage individual and team performance against agreed objectives. Scale the sales organisation in line with business growth. New Business & Sales Development Lead the identification, qualification and conversion of new business opportunities. Personally manage and support significant or strategic sales opportunities. Build relationships with senior decision-makers across corporate, education, government, institutional and channel markets. Develop compelling commercial propositions and sales approaches. Lead negotiations and manage opportunities through to successful completion. Work closely with the Vice President / European Managing Director on major regional opportunities and strategic accounts. Strategic Accounts & Partnerships Develop and maintain strong relationships with key customers and strategic partners. Establish account-development plans for major customers. Identify opportunities for account growth, cross-selling and expansion. Work with the wider organisation to ensure strong customer retention and development. Support the Vice President / European Managing Director in developing significant regional partnerships and business relationships. Sales Operations & Forecasting Establish and maintain effective sales processes and operating rhythms. Own sales pipeline management and ensure opportunities are accurately recorded and progressed. Develop robust sales forecasting and reporting. Establish appropriate sales KPIs and performance dashboards. Monitor conversion rates, sales cycles, pipeline value and other key performance indicators. Ensure accurate and timely reporting to the Vice President / European Managing Director and President. Continuously improve sales processes, tools, systems and methodologies. Market & Customer Insight Market & Customer Insight Maintain a strong understanding of customer needs, buying behaviours, market trends and competitive activity across the relevant markets. Translate market and customer insight into actionable sales opportunities and priorities. Gather and communicate customer and prospect feedback to inform propositions, messaging and product development. Monitor competitor activity and market positioning. Provide the Vice President / European Managing Director with regular insight into market opportunities, customer sentiment and emerging trends.
